union-square-ventures._readme: Durable identity corrections (COLLECTION.md §8), written at kickoff 2026-09-05 before the first build. Canonical = the firm's own current rendering on usv.com/companies/ (or, for companies no longer listed, the firm's last rendering); duplicates are the archived listing eras' earlier names, renames and merger successors. Re-check that ledger verdicts still attach after any change here.

merges.reason: 10gen renamed MongoDB Inc. (2013); listed as 10gen 2008-2012, MongoDB since
eShares renamed Carta (2017); listed as eShares in 2015
Stack Overflow's company was Stack Exchange Inc. 2011-2015 (the firm's 2011 post 'Stack Overflow becomes Stack Exchange'); the live site lists Stack Overflow

Helium Inc. renamed Nova Labs (2022); listed as Helium 2019-2022, Nova Labs since; Helium Systems, Inc. is the legal name of Helium / Nova Labs (Form D 2019, Nick Grossman as director); one row with the site's Nova Labs
the 2022 listing named the protocol (zkSync); the live site names the company, Matter Labs (zkSync)
the 2023 listing said Ceramic; the live site says Ceramic/3Box Labs (3Box Labs builds Ceramic)

YouNow Inc. (listed 2013-2020, Series A 2012) relaunched as Props (the live row 'Props, Series A, 2012', status inactive); one company, one entry. Flagged duplicate_suspected for the judge to confirm the lineage
DroneBase renamed Zeitview (2023); listed as Dronebase 2015-2023
Onename (2015) became Blockstack (2016-2021) became Stacks / Hiro Systems; the live site lists Stacks
Hailo (USV's 2013 entry) merged into Daimler's mytaxi in 2016; mytaxi renamed FREE NOW in 2019; the live site lists FREE NOW
Pinch Media (USV's 2009 listing) merged with Flurry in December 2009; the firm listed Flurry from 2010 (acquired by Yahoo 2014)
AdaptiveBlue renamed GetGlue (2010); the live site lists GetGlue (acquired by i.TV 2013)
Instant Information Inc. (listed 2005-2008) became InfoNgen / Info(N)Gen (listed 2009-2018); no longer on the live site
Patch Homes renamed Noah (2020); the live site lists Noah
SilviaTerra renamed NCX (2021); the live site lists NCX
THE Football App (listed 2014) is Onefootball; the live site lists Onefootball
Sift Science renamed Sift (2018); listed 2013-2019 as Sift Science and in 2019 as Sift, no longer on the live site; the build keeps the longer archived rendering, the note records the current name
the 2017-2018 card linked pilotfiber.com; the live site lists Pilot
WP Technology Inc. is Wattpad's legal name (Form D 2014, Albert Wenger as director); the live site lists Wattpad
Leapfrog Power, Inc. is Leap's legal name (Form Ds 2019-2023, Nick Grossman as director); the live site lists Leap
iShopShops, Inc. is ShopShops' legal name (Form Ds 2019-2022, Rebecca Kaden as director); the live site lists ShopShops

Distributed Creation Inc. is Splice's legal name: its Form D seed ($2.75M, sale 2013-10-07) is the round the firm's 2013-10-09 post announces, Andrew Weissman (USV) and Jared Hecht (Steve Martocci's GroupMe co-founder, an angel director) sit on the board, and the November-2020 $55M filing is Splice's Series D
REVOS (the 2022 listing name; the firm's 2021-09 post 'REVOS') renamed Bolt.Earth; the live site lists BOLT with the REVOS post linked
Ryzac, Inc. is Codecademy's legal name (Form D 2011 seed and 2021 $40M Series D, Andy Weissman as director)
Adelante Financial Holdings Ltd (Colombia) is ADDI's parent (Form Ds 2018-2021, John Buttrick as director on the 2021 Series B USV announced)
Digicash Technology Venture Ltd. (Brazil) is alt.bank's issuer (Form Ds 2020-2025, John Buttrick as director; USV led the 2020 Series A)
Nvest, Inc. is SigFig's legal name (Form Ds 2013-2018, John Buttrick as director; USV's 2013 Series B)
Pollen, Inc. is C2FO's legal entity (Pollenware; Form Ds 2010-2025, John Buttrick as director; USV led the 2012 Series B)
Narvii Inc. is Amino Apps' legal name (Form Ds 2014-2015, Andy Weissman as director; USV's 2014 Series A)
Flip (flip.lease, listed 2017-2021) rebranded as Caretaker; the live row Caretaker links the 2017 'Flip' post
GIC Technologies, Inc. (New York, inc. 2025; $11M Form D Q4 2025, Rebecca Kaden as director) is The General Intelligence Company of New York, whose seed round USV led in December 2025 (own post)
